subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All poets are writers.Some writers are critics. No critic is a fool.

Conclusions:

I. Some poets are critics.

II. Some writers are not fools.
solution:
**Statement:** All poets are writers.Some writers are critics. No critic is a fool.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d46eb1ea7e711e78ab1c66a3b85b0b18554356a8eb5d75aef3c5b21af09c14.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some poets are critics. - False (Some poets being critics is possible but it is not definite. So, the conclusion is false)

II. Some writers are not fools. - **True** (Some writers are critics. No critic is a fool, which means some writers who are critics are not fools)

Thus, only II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
